tool_args.rationale: Fit the recalled saturating sink-gradient mechanism numerically to the seven observations and test it on fresh confirmation. The supercritical branch remains unidentifiable from these measurements, so confirmation is necessary rather than claiming it has been established.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All measured gradients are at or below 2.35, so the proposed threshold and avalanche coefficient cannot be fitted; the specified high-gradient probe is not in the available menu.
The open-branch observations show a strong gradient-dependent suppression, while the pilot is saturating; neither recalled formula captures both features as specified.
It is more expensive and is not specified as discriminating the unresolved high-gradient branch.
